description_en: 📍 Location: Between "21 Djetori" and "Myslym Shyri" Streets, on the second line from the main street, near all necessary services (supermarkets, schools, pharmacies, urban transport, etc.). 📐 Total area: 110 m² 🏠 Typology: 3 bedrooms + 1 living room + 2 toilets (2nd floor) The apartment has a very functional organization of an existing building.
